recalculation_rules.trigger: Recalculate automatically on every inline input change or line save.

status_based_locking.behavior: When status is 'Finalizată' (or Invoiced/Closed), all table inputs become disabled/read-only, add/edit/delete buttons are hidden or disabled, and a persistent lock banner is displayed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor WorkOrderDetail.js and WorkOrders.js to use full-width single column workspace layout.
Implement inline editing directly on table rows using stateful inline input fields or inline popovers for labor and parts.
Ensure immediate automatic recalculation of subtotal Manoperă, subtotal Piese, TVA (19%), and Total Deviz upon editing any cell.
Enforce status locking: when work order status is 'Finalizată', disable all editing actions and show lock status banner.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all editable inputs, buttons, totals, and table rows.
Use standard JavaScript (.js) files as configured in the frontend codebase.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on floating panels, dropdowns, or sticky headers. Always combine background colors with backdrop-blur.
Ensure high contrast APCA standards for dark theme text (e.g., text-slate-100 on bg-[#111723]).
All interactive elements MUST contain data-testid attributes for automated testing.
